# DECCAN — Card List

<!-- GENERATED FROM sim/cards.mjs BY `npm run cards`. DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE. -->

**8 rulers × 8 units = 64 cards, plus 15 Power Brokers — 79 in the box.**

## The ring

> ELEPHANT → RIFLEMAN → CANNON → HORSEMAN → WARRIOR → back to ELEPHANT

Each arm cancels the **next two** along the ring, and is cancelled by the two behind it.

| Arm | Force unit | Power Broker | cancels | cancelled by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **ELEPHANT** | Elephant **9** | Siege Elephant **10** | RIFLEMAN, CANNON | HORSEMAN, WARRIOR |
| **CANNON** | Cannon **7** | Sultan Rockets **8** | HORSEMAN, WARRIOR | ELEPHANT, RIFLEMAN |
| **HORSEMAN** | Horseman **5** | Spy **6** | WARRIOR, ELEPHANT | RIFLEMAN, CANNON |
| **RIFLEMAN** | Rifleman **3** | Sepoy **4** | CANNON, HORSEMAN | ELEPHANT, WARRIOR |
| **WARRIOR** | Warrior **1** | Subhedar **2** | ELEPHANT, RIFLEMAN | CANNON, HORSEMAN |

Force strengths are **odd** and Power Broker strengths **even**, so a Force unit and a broker
can never tie, and every broker is exactly one better than its own arm's Force unit.

## The eight rulers

Each holds 8 units. Every ruler holds at least one of every arm, so every ruler can
answer every arm; what differs is where its spare cards sit. Note that most rulers carry the
arm that answers their own — the Sultan's elephants are cancelled by warriors, so the Sultan
fields warriors. The counts are set by measurement, one ruler at a time, not by a formula.

| Ruler | | Force | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| **The Sultan** | three elephant + two warrior | E9 E9 E9 C7 H5 R3 W1 W1 | 44 |
| **The Badshah** | three cannon + two warrior | E9 C7 C7 C7 H5 R3 W1 W1 | 40 |
| **The Peshwa** | four horseman | E9 C7 H5 H5 H5 H5 R3 W1 | 40 |
| **The Governor** | three rifleman + two warrior | E9 C7 H5 R3 R3 R3 W1 W1 | 32 |
| **The Rana** | three warrior + two horseman | E9 C7 H5 H5 R3 W1 W1 W1 | 32 |
| **The Nizam** | three cannon + two horseman | E9 C7 C7 C7 H5 H5 R3 W1 | 44 |
| **The Nawab** | three rifleman + two cannon | E9 C7 C7 H5 R3 R3 R3 W1 | 38 |
| **The Maharaja** | three horseman + two warrior | E9 C7 H5 H5 H5 R3 W1 W1 | 36 |

*The Sultan — war elephants, and the foot that walks beside them.*  
*The Badshah — the imperial gun train and its levies.*  
*The Peshwa — Ganimi Kava, and horse that never stands.*  
*The Governor — matchlocks drilled off the ships.*  
*The Rana — the last stand on foot, and riders to reach it.*  
*The Nizam — guns, and the horse that screens them.*  
*The Nawab — a fortress of musket and cannon.*  
*The Maharaja — horse and foot, and nothing bought.*  

## The supply

3 of each, 15 cards. Recruited by **losing** — one per defeated player,
whatever they committed.

| Power Broker | | Arm | Timing | Ability |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| **Siege Elephant** | 10 | ELEPHANT | **ON DEPLOY** | Deploy FACE UP. LOOK at one enemy unit — it stays face up. |
| **Sultan Rockets** | 8 | CANNON | **ON DEFEAT** | Deploy FACE UP. Burn the winning army's recovering units. |
| **Spy** | 6 | HORSEMAN | **ON REVEAL** | EXCHANGE with the enemy's strongest unit. PERMANENT — each card joins the other force for good. |
| **Sepoy** | 4 | RIFLEMAN | **ON REVEAL** | ALONE in your army: double strength. |
| **Subhedar** | 2 | WARRIOR | **ON REVEAL** | REMOVE the enemy's weakest unit. |

**ON DEPLOY** — when the card is committed, before anything is revealed. Cancellation cannot
stop it. **ON REVEAL** — the abilities step of the battle: the ring resolves first, so only
survivors act. **ON DEFEAT** — after the ground is decided, if this card survived and its army
did not take it.
